# Youssef Elsaid — Software Engineer & AI Architect

> Expert Software Engineer and AI Architect from Alexandria, Egypt, with 10+ years of coding experience since age 8. Specializing in Python, Machine Learning, Full-Stack Architecture, and real-time intelligent systems.

## Summary & Core Identity
Youssef Elsaid (widely known online as pplo) is a seasoned software engineer and artificial intelligence architect based in Alexandria, Egypt. With over 10 years of software engineering experience spanning more than 30 programming languages, he creates intelligent systems, machine learning architectures, and scalable full-stack applications.

## Key Statistical Highlights
- **10+ Years of Experience**: Building production software and AI models since 2016.
- **30+ Programming Languages**: Fluency in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, Go, Rust, PHP, SQL, and Dart.
- **4+ Years of R&D**: Dedicated to creating A3rbly, the premier AI engine for Arabic grammatical syntax parsing.
- **100,000+ Monthly Requests**: Handled across client deployments with 99.9% measured uptime.
- **50+ Completed Solutions**: Spanning edtech, gaming commerce, NLP models, and microservices.

## Selected Projects & Inventions
- [A3rbly](https://a3rbly.com): State-of-the-art AI system for automated Arabic grammatical analysis (I'rab) powered by customized NLP algorithms.
- [Steam1st Store](https://steam1st.store): High-performance digital gaming storefront utilizing Flask, PostgreSQL, and secure payment processing.
- [Alcoders](https://alcoders.com): Developer community platform and programming collaboration hub.
- [EasyBio](https://easybio-drabdelrahman.com): Dedicated e-learning portal serving secondary school biology students in Egypt.
- [PPLO-GPT](https://pplo.vercel.app): Conversational AI assistant utilizing Python, NLP pipelines, and machine learning models.
- [Kotobee](https://kotobee.com): Core backend development and architecture for international digital publishing platform.
